problem.title: Count Nodes Equal to Average of Subtree

approaches.title: Postorder subtree aggregation
approaches.summary: Uses a recursive postorder traversal that returns each subtree's sum, node count, and number of matching averages. Each node is evaluated from its children's aggregates.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implemented recursive postorder aggregation using mutable sum and count accumulators, then checked each subtree's integer average.
Refactored the same traversal to destructure child results and compute each subtree's aggregates more directly and idiomatically.
